overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Active Core International Equity ETF (TACN) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TACN is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth by investing in large- and mid-cap companies listed in developed markets excluding the US and Canada TACN was launched on Dec 10, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.

data.title: How to Diversify Away From AI Concentration
data.text: Investors looking to diversify their U.S. growth portfolios away from artificial intelligence may want to check how concentrated that exposure has become, according to new research from T. Rowe Price.
